metadata.source: United Energy 2026-27 Pricing (structure) + United Energy 2026-27 SCS pricing model filed with the AER (7 May 2026; rates)
metadata.notes: Excluding GST. Residential ToU URSTOU: peak 4pm-9pm, saver 11am-4pm, off-peak 9pm-11am, all days, rates from the United Energy 2026-27 SCS pricing model filed with the AER (7 May 2026; knowledge/documents/united-energy/2026-11-10-scs-pricing-model-2026-27). Small business ToU peak is 9am-9pm workdays. Residential/export CER tariffs (URCER; priced in the 2026-27 sources but not yet seeded, tracked separately) and all demand-charge tariffs (LVMKW1R/UMBD/UMBO/large/HV) are NOT seeded -- same reasoning as citipower.json/powercor.json (single-window demand schema can't represent United Energy's two-season summer/non-summer demand charge without an unmade modeling decision). Source PDF gives tariff codes/structure but not $ rates -- those live in the United Energy 2026-27 SCS pricing model filed with the AER (7 May 2026), which gives the rates of every seeded tariff here (LVS1R, LVDed, URSTOU, LVM1R, LVTOU); the rows other than residential ToU are recorded in knowledge/findings/2026-11-10-victorian-2026-27-non-tou-network-rates (#73). The AER TSS.01 indicative-prices spreadsheet (Jan2025 proposal) is no longer a rate source for any seeded tariff.

tariffs.name: Residential Single Rate
tariffs.notes: Rates checked 2026-11-10 against knowledge/documents/united-energy/2026-11-10-scs-pricing-model-2026-27 (sheet Tariff schedule, Tariff schedule 3, row 86, excluding GST): fixed 31.51 c/day, anytime 9.72 c/kWh. Rows recorded in knowledge/findings/2026-11-10-victorian-2026-27-non-tou-network-rates (#73). Windows and time_basis unchanged.

tariffs.name: Residential ToU
tariffs.notes: Rates checked 2026-11-10 against knowledge/documents/united-energy/2026-11-10-scs-pricing-model-2026-27 (sheet Tariff schedule, Tariff schedule 3, row 88, excluding GST): fixed 31.51 c/day, peak 20.92, off-peak 5.22 and saver 1.00 c/kWh. Windows from knowledge/documents/united-energy/2026-10-21-pricing-2026-27: peak 16:00-21:00, saver 11:00-16:00, off-peak 21:00-11:00, all days. The source states no time basis for this tariff; time_basis stays local (#68).

tariffs.name: Dedicated Circuit
tariffs.notes: Rates checked 2026-11-10 against knowledge/documents/united-energy/2026-11-10-scs-pricing-model-2026-27 (sheet Tariff schedule, Tariff schedule 3, row 87, excluding GST): fixed 0.00 c/day, dedicated circuit 1.00 c/kWh. Rows recorded in knowledge/findings/2026-11-10-victorian-2026-27-non-tou-network-rates (#73). The source gives the dedicated circuit rate in its off-peak column with no window; it stays an all-day controlled_load rate.
